title: Answer Wire Response v0.1
description: The official EXTERNAL GET /answer response contract (CLAUDE.md section 0/2, updated per organizer API notice). This is deliberately NOT final-response.schema.json: that schema describes the Agent's INTERNAL FinalResponse shape (retrieved_context as an array, think_trace as an object) that domain/runtime/agent-runtime.mjs's createSerializer() produces and Flows exchange with the Runtime Host. This schema describes the five-string WIRE body every external caller (including the Evaluation Harness) actually receives over HTTP. domain/runtime/answer-wire-response.mjs converts between the two -- see toAnswerWireResponse/fromAnswerWireResponse -- and is the only place that conversion happens; nothing else should hand-roll it.

question_id.description: The correlation identifier exactly as supplied on the request's question_id query parameter. The request boundary is authoritative for this value -- it is never self-declared by a runner/Flow.

question.description: The Agent's own FinalResponse.question, always equal to the request's question query parameter (see domain/runtime/answer-handler.mjs's request<->response question binding gate).

retrieved_context.description: The internal FinalResponse.retrieved_context array, JSON.stringify()-encoded. A caller must JSON.parse() this string to recover the array -- see domain/runtime/answer-wire-response.mjs's fromAnswerWireResponse().

think_trace.description: The internal FinalResponse.think_trace object (execution_mode/operations/calculation/validation only -- never a raw execution_trace, hidden chain-of-thought, system prompt, or secret), JSON.stringify()-encoded. A caller must JSON.parse() this string to recover the object.
